instruction: Remove Google Chrome from favorites and add Files instead.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires replacing google-chrome.desktop with org.gnome.Nautilus.desktop (Files app). Initial state has Thunderbird, Vim, and Chrome. The evaluator checks that the final state contains Thunderbird, Vim, and Files (order doesn't matter due to set comparison). Uses existing check_gnome_favorite_apps metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts GNOME favorite apps state via gsettings command
Metric correctly compares result against expected apps using set comparison (order-agnostic)
Complete requirement coverage: verifies Chrome is removed and Files is added while preserving other apps
Metric correctly handles expected parameter as rules dict (expected.type='rule' → metric receives rules dict directly)
Length validation ensures exact number of apps match
No postconfig needed - gsettings state can be queried anytime after task completion
Logic flow is semantically sound and will work correctly at runtime
